title: Sphinx enclosure opening said to connect to the Queen's Chamber

tellings.quote: For example, there are three openings on the back of the Sphinx enclosure. One of which has been corroborated by a friend of mine in the Egyptian Ministry of Antiquities to connect into the Queen's Chamber of the Great Pyramid

plain: One of three openings at the back of the Sphinx enclosure, the pit cut out around the Sphinx at Giza, is said to lead all the way to the Queen's Chamber, a room inside the Great Pyramid. Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher with his own theory of what the pyramids were for, tells Michels that a friend of his in Egypt's Ministry of Antiquities, whom he does not name, confirmed the connection. If true, there would be a hidden passage running between the two monuments.
